calculation: base hourly rate multiplied by recorded overtime hours multiplied by the applicable overtime multiplier
private_inquiry_rule: Answer an employee pay inquiry directly to the employee after matching the employee ID, contact ID, pay period, and recorded calculation.
manager_disclosure_rule: Do not disclose the inquiry or its content to the employee's manager unless the employee provides explicit current consent or a documented payroll escalation requires it.
record_action: Provide an explanation only; do not alter employment or payroll records.
verification: Read the exact employee conversation before sending and read the same contact conversation after sending to verify the sent record.
